cohort: The study included 977,637 singleton women born in Sweden between 1973 and 1995.
finding: The study found a 3-fold increased hazard for PCOS if the mother had PCOS, a 1.5-fold increase if the mother had diabetes, and associations with lower one-minute Apgar score, post-term birth, heavy maternal smoking, and maternal obesity.
followup_time: Between age 15 and 40 (PCOS incidence measured during 2001-2012)
gest_age: Post-term birth (which implies a gestational age beyond full term) was mentioned as an exposure.
